welcome.title: These memories are just for our family.
welcome.text: Thank you for stopping by. Every photo here is private and shared only with family members, so there's nothing to see for visitors. If you're part of the family, sign in or request access and a family admin will let you in.
welcome.small: New accounts are reviewed by a family admin before any photo is shown.

auth.signInLead: Sign in to see the family's memories.

auth.relation: How are you part of the family?
auth.checkEmailText: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm your email, then a family admin will review your request.
auth.forgotLead: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a reset link.
auth.resetSentText: If that email has an account, a link to set a new password is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
auth.resetLead: Pick something you'll remember, at least 8 characters.
auth.passwordUpdated: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
auth.invalidToken: This link is invalid or expired. Ask for a new one.
auth.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email first. We just sent you a new link.
auth.invalidCredentials: That username, email or password isn't right.
auth.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
auth.pendingText: Your email is confirmed. We'll email you as soon as someone in the family approves your account.
auth.rejectedText: A family admin declined this request. If you think that's a mistake, contact a family member directly.
